title: Sr. Executive - Condition Monitoring Engineer
requiredSkills: Data analytics; anomaly detection; diagnostics applications; Python
jobDescription: The company is looking for a Condition Monitoring Engineer to collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to design, develop, and deploy self-diagnostic tools for industrial equipment. The role involves leveraging expertise in statistics, machine learning, and vibration analysis to analyze large datasets and derive actionable insights on equipment health and performance. The engineer will develop and implement algorithms for fault and anomaly detection using both historical and real-time sensor data, integrating these algorithms into software applications or embedded systems for real-time monitoring. Participation in field trials and deployments will be essential to validate tool performance and refine systems based on field feedback.
